cues: A hub is a dumb repeater: a frame from A to D is copied to every port, wasting bandwidth and causing collisions.
A switch learns which MAC address sits on which port and sends the frame only to D.
text: Network devices. A hub is a dumb repeater: a frame from A to D is copied to every port, wasting bandwidth and causing collisions. A switch learns which MAC address sits on which port and sends the frame only to D.
